           VANILLA AROMATICA

         Vanilla

        (VANILLA - PLANIFOLIA)


Marked skin irritation resembling milk Poison-oak; is sometimes produced
        by handling the beans, also by local use of vanilla essence in a hair wash. Vanilla is
        supposed to stimulate the brain and sexual propensities. Do not use the synthetic Vanilla
        extract. Various disorders of the nervous system and circulation are produced in workers
        with Vanilla. Is an emmagogue and aphrodisiac. Menses prolonged.



Dose.--  Vanilla, 6th to 30th, has been found effective in
        curing the skin affection.
